This wheat plot is small, only a quarter hectare, but wheat needs fertilizer to give a good harvest, so I will try to get DAP and urea from the cooperative like last year, though the supply comes late sometimes. I cannot afford improved seed every year for all my plots, but for wheat on this plot I will use seed I saved from last harvest because the improved wheat seed is expensive and not always available in time. I have no money for pesticides, and there is no irrigation here — we depend on the meher rains. My daughter-in-law and I will do most of the work ourselves, but for ploughing with the oxen and for harvest time I will ask a neighbor to help for a few days in exchange for some grain.
